''See also: [[The Mad King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Mad King]] is a powerful [[Vroshir]] and former [[Executor]] who has become a major adversary to the [[Abidan]]. Recognized as a Class One threat, he possesses an entity capable of killing [[Judges]] and has developed methods to hide his existence from Way{{!}}the Way. He is a conqueror and an imperialist known for seeking legendary deeds, often acting as a one-man force of devastation. His combat capabilities include the use of a black The Scythe{{!}}Scythe and a bone [[sword]] that carries the weight of many destroyed worlds. He has even successfully struck at the pillars of Heaven, testing both the foresight of [[Makiel]] and the response times of the [[Abidan]]. He resides in a citadel located on the [[fortress]]-world of [[Tal’gullour]], a place he loves and has brought his people to protect. Despite his reputation for cruelty toward others, he is described as being generous to his own subjects. He has utilized a cursed virus to spread chaos and transform others into violent, hungry creatures. While he is a formidable ruler, his physical state has suffered; his [[madra channels]] are scarred and his lifeline is thin, appearing as though he has endured a long illness. He has also been known to lock himself in sealed chambers to prevent his mental instability from destroying his [[Iteration]]. His primary motivation appears to be the total [[destruction]] of the [[Abidan]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Mad King]] is clad in armor made of bone. His eyes are red and resemble two suns.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A former [[Executor]] recruited by the [[Abidan]], he now harbors a hatred for them. He hosts an entity capable of killing [[Judges]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He wields a scythe and possesses a gaze that can see across time and space. Additionally, he has the power to seal off sectors and place barriers and obstacles within Way{{!}}the Way.}}
